verdict.rationale: Canva's Connect APIs and MCP server both provide documented programmatic export capability — the MCP server explicitly supports 'Design export: Generate exports in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4, etc.) and resize designs for different channels', and the Connect APIs allow creating/syncing designs and assets with OpenAPI-generated SDKs, confirmed via a live probe of the MCP docs. This directly satisfies an agent's need to render/export designs programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of actual export calls succeeding (no third-party corroboration, only first-party docs), and the OpenAPI spec itself wasn't resolvable via direct probe.
